summary: Frontend-only verification of the republished sidebar logo fix against the public URL. The fallback implementation works structurally on desktop and mobile: the sidebar contains data-testid='sidebar-school-logo', renders an IMG rather than the prior generic SVG/book icon, and loads /school-logo.png successfully. However, the shipped PNG is not the expected Virgin Mary school logo; it is a 1916x1022 screenshot of an Attendance Tracking browser page, rendered as a tiny unreadable thumbnail in the sidebar. Therefore the core visual requirement is not fully fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: The fallback image renders, but /public/school-logo.png contains an Attendance Tracking webpage screenshot instead of the expected Virgin Mary logo with yellow background. The sidebar consequently shows a tiny webpage thumbnail rather than the school logo.

issues: The fallback asset has a 1916x1022 landscape aspect ratio and is compressed into a 56x56 container, making it appear as a mostly white miniature screenshot rather than recognizable school branding.

action_items: Replace /app/frontend/public/school-logo.png with the intended Virgin Mary school logo on the yellow background, republish, and verify the 56x56 sidebar rendering visually.
Optionally add an image onError fallback so a non-empty but broken school.logo_url also falls back to /school-logo.png.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js correctly uses school?.logo_url || '/school-logo.png' for missing values, and the tested school with empty logo_url used the fallback. The fallback asset itself is incorrect: PNG decoding passes, but its content and 1916x1022 dimensions identify it as a webpage screenshot, not a logo.
The fallback expression handles null/empty logo_url but not a populated URL that returns an error; an onError handler would prevent a broken image in that case.

success_rate.frontend: 67% (2/3 requested outcomes passed; correct school-logo appearance failed)

seed_data_creation: None. Testing used the supplied existing teacher account and made no data changes.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md and successfully authenticated with the supplied test@school.edu teacher account. The expired trial redirected the session to pricing, where Layout and the sidebar remained available for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-test the public /school-logo.png response and log in with test@school.edu. Assert sidebar-school-logo is visible, currentSrc ends in /school-logo.png, naturalWidth is nonzero, its parent logo link has zero SVG elements, and visually confirm the asset is the Virgin Mary/yellow logo rather than the current Attendance Tracking screenshot. Desktop and mobile structural checks already pass.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: log in, inspect [data-testid='sidebar-school-logo'], and open /school-logo.png directly. The IMG loads HTTP 200 image/png and has natural dimensions 1916x1022, but the decoded pixels show an Attendance Tracking webpage screenshot. Layout's fallback logic is working; the wrong static file was placed at the fallback path.
